ThingDef.label: rockbread
ThingDef.description: Extremely hard and crunchy bread, baked with as few ingredients as possible. It can resist for years on end, and the heft makes it a viable blunt weapon as well.

ThingDef.label: jelly pastry
ThingDef.description: Sweet, soft and warm treats glazed with insect jelly. They're a great dessert and a valuable product to sell.

ThingDef.label: berry pie
ThingDef.description: Sweet, warm pie made with berries. Warms the soul and heart.

ThingDef.label: chocolate pie
ThingDef.description: Smooth, delicious pie made with chocolate. Warms the soul and heart.

ThingDef.label: baked cheesecake
ThingDef.description: Soft, springy cheesecake made with dwarven cheese. Warms the soul and heart.

ThingDef.label: spongecake
ThingDef.description: Fluffy spongecake, with a layer of bitter nectar. Warms the soul and heart.

ThingDef.label: butter tarts
ThingDef.description: Puffy, flaky tarts with a distinct butter flavor and a gooey buttery filling. They're a great dessert and a valuable product to sell.

ThingDef.label: pancakes
ThingDef.description: Flour, milk and butter mixed into batter, baked on a pan and served with sweet syrup.

ThingDef.label: dwarven cheese
ThingDef.description: Soft, smooth cheese inside of a hard waxy shell. The result of a long dry-aging process.

ThingDef.label: fresh cheese
ThingDef.description: Fresh cheese that needs to be dry-aged before being consumed.

ThingDef.label: cured meat
ThingDef.description: Cleaned and salted meat. Cured by hanging it off a rack for a prolonged amount of time.\n\nIt can still be used for dishes, but can also be eaten raw.

ThingDef.label: salted fish
ThingDef.description: Degutted and salted fish. Dried by hanging it off a rack for a prolonged amount of time.\n\nIt can still be used for dishes, but can also be eaten raw.

ThingDef.label: dried human meat
ThingDef.description: Treated human flesh. Dried by hanging it off a rack for a prolonged amount of time.\n\nIt can still be used for dishes, but can also be eaten raw.

ThingDef.label: insect jerky
ThingDef.description: Marinated insect meat. Cured by hanging it off a rack for a prolonged amount of time.\n\nIt can still be used for dishes, but can also be eaten raw.

ThingDef.label: meat rockpie
ThingDef.description: Meat mixed with spices and herbs, thickened with flour and baked into a hard rockbread shell, which moistens with baking.

ThingDef.label: vegan rockpie
ThingDef.description: Assorted vegetables diced and mixed with herbs, thickened with flour and baked into a hard rockbread shell, which moistens with baking.

ThingDef.label: mushroom rockpie
ThingDef.description: Fungus sliced and mixed with spices, thickened with flour and baked into a hard rockbread shell, which moistens with baking

ThingDef.label: jelly glazed shank
ThingDef.description: The thigh or shank of an animal, scored, spiced and oven baked to perfection. During baking it's glazed with a tangy sauce made from insect jelly.

ThingDef.label: jelly glazed shank (cold)
ThingDef.description: The thigh or shank of an animal, scored, spiced and oven baked to perfection. During baking it's glazed with a tangy sauce made from insect jelly.\n\nThis feast has been refridgerated or frozen, and isn't as tasty anymore.

ThingDef.label: roasted megascarab
ThingDef.description: A fresh megascarab, expertly cut and cleaned, then roasted in the oven along with fungus and spices. The shell keeps the meat inside delicate and moist.

ThingDef.label: roasted megascarab (cold)
ThingDef.description: A fresh megascarab, expertly cut and cleaned, then roasted in the oven along with fungus and spices. The shell keeps the meat inside delicate and moist.\n\nThis feast has been refridgerated or frozen, and isn't as tasty anymore.

ThingDef.label: cream of mushroom soup
ThingDef.description: A simple roux of dwarven milk, mixed with fungus and herbs, slow-cooked in the oven and then served with softened rockbread slices. This is the most common meal eaten by stoneborn miners.

ThingDef.label: cream of mushroom soup (cold)
ThingDef.description: A simple roux of dwarven milk, mixed with fungus and herbs, slow-cooked in the oven and then served with softened rockbread slices.\n\nThis feast has been refridgerated or frozen, and isn't as tasty anymore.

ThingDef.label: rockdough pizza
ThingDef.description: Dough spread out and hammered into shape, topped with sauce first, then with dwarven cheese, and various vegetables. Sliced right out the oven for the best cheese pulls.

ThingDef.label: rockdough pizza (cold)
ThingDef.description: Dough spread out and hammered into shape, topped with sauce first, then with dwarven cheese, and various vegetables. Sliced right out the oven for the best cheese pulls.\n\nThis feast has been refridgerated or frozen, and isn't as tasty anymore.

ThingDef.label: crusted fillet
ThingDef.description: A fine fillet, seared lightly, then wrapped firstly in a mushroom duxelles, followed by a layer of pastry dough. The dough is then basted with melted butter right before baking.\n\n<color=#6e6e6eff>One of Gorestone Ramsay's signature dishes, a direct quote from a recipe holovid: "Look at it.. I'm ready to die, and go to heaven.."</color>

ThingDef.label: crusted fillet (cold)
ThingDef.description: A fine fillet, seared lightly, then wrapped firstly in a mushroom duxelles, followed by a layer of pastry dough. The dough is then basted with melted butter right before baking.\n\nThis feast has been refridgerated or frozen, and isn't as tasty anymore.

ThingDef.label: ice cream
ThingDef.description: Creamy, sweet cold cream. Nourishes the soul.

ThingDef.label: ice cream (melted)
ThingDef.description: Creamy, sweet cold cream. Nourishes the soul.\n\nThis feast has been let out in the heat for too long and has melted. It can be refrozen.

ThingDef.label: meat skewer
ThingDef.description: Meat skewered and grilled, glazed with sauces. Not incredibly nutritious, but tasty.

ThingDef.label: veggie skewer
ThingDef.description: Vegetables skewered and grilled, glazed with sauces. Not incredibly nutritious, but tasty.

ThingDef.label: mushroom skewer
ThingDef.description: Fungus skewered and grilled, glazed with sauces. Not incredibly nutritious, but tasty.

ThingDef.label: insect meat skewer
ThingDef.description: Insect meat skewered and grilled, glazed with sauces. Not incredibly nutritious, but tasty.

ThingDef.label: cheese rockburger
ThingDef.description: Meat minced and grilled to perfect medium rare, then topped with dwarven cheese.

ThingDef.label: veggie rockburger
ThingDef.description: Vegetables minced and formed into a patty, then grilled and topped with fresh vegetables.

ThingDef.label: cave rockburger
ThingDef.description: Insect meat minced and grilled fully, then topped with sliced caramelized fungus.

ThingDef.label: meat rockwich
ThingDef.description: Raw slices of meat finely cut and placed within two slices of rockbread.

ThingDef.label: veggie rockwich
ThingDef.description: Seasoned vegetables placed within two slices of rockbread.

ThingDef.label: grilled cheese
ThingDef.description: Dwarven cheese placed within two slices of rockbread, then grilled.

ThingDef.label: brickloaf
ThingDef.description: A large sheet of hard focaccia cut into manageable bricks. Last for an incredibly long time.

ThingDef.label: omelette
ThingDef.description: Assorted diced vegetables mixed with milk and eggs, then cooked in a pan.

ThingDef.label: grilled steak
ThingDef.description: A hefty cut of meat, grilled to a perfect medium rare.

ThingDef.label: eggs n' bacon
ThingDef.description: Sunny side up eggs with a side of greasy, salty bacon.

ThingDef.label: poutine
ThingDef.description: Soft potato chips draped with gravy and topped with cheese curds.\n\n<color=#6e6e6eff>Through every corner stoneborn have spread, many cultural foods have been picked up and adopted by chefs, including many old Earth recipes.</color>

ThingDef.label: cheesesteak
ThingDef.description: Warm rockbread, sliced open and stuffed with hot meat and melted cheese.

ThingDef.label: rockbull roast
ThingDef.description: A tender, flavorful roast rubbed with herbs that melts in the mouth.

ThingDef.label: country-fried muffalo
ThingDef.description: A crispy breaded steak served with a side of mashed potatoes and smooth gravy.

ThingDef.label: crispy megasloth belly
ThingDef.description: Fatty belly crisped up for a long time inside an oven, plated with a sweet and spicy sauce.

ThingDef.label: thrumbo tomahwak
ThingDef.description: A hefty rib covered in a sweet, minty sauce, served along sauteed vegetables.
